description: The bar chart, titled "Quality Scores," compares the performance of three different methods—IFD, Quality Scores, and DEITA—across two evaluation metrics: Avg₆₆ and Avg₅₆. The vertical axis represents the scores, ranging from 30 to 70, while the horizontal axis lists the three methods. For each method, two bars are displayed: a light blue bar for Avg₆₆ and a light orange bar for Avg₅₆. The chart also includes two horizontal reference lines: a dashed blue line at 65 labeled "Base Avg₆₆" and a dashed yellow line at 38 labeled "Base Avg₅₆." The scores for each method are as follows: IFD has an Avg₆₆ score of 63.98 and an Avg₅₆ score of 41.90; Quality Scores has an Avg₆₆ score of 66.06 and an Avg₅₆ score of 39.13; and DEITA has an Avg₆₆ score of 67.64 and an Avg₅₆ score of 42.99. The legend in the top right corner clarifies the color coding for the different metrics and base averages.
